name: Guangdong True Health Medical Technology Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong True Health Medical Technology Development Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures and sells surgical robots and disposables in China and Hong Kong. Its products include percutaneous puncture surgery robots (TH-S1, TH-S, TH-S Pro and TH-SA) and microwave ablation surgical robots for treating liver and lung tumors.
